title: CozyCoveMC
description: CozyCove is a Cozy server with quality of life plugins focused on building, survival and having fun! (18+) We host semi-regular events where you can compete for rewards and have many great builders
body:
A little about us:

- We are an 18+ mainly vanilla server avaliable to join on Bedrock and Java
- QoL Plugins like Claims, Simple Voice Chat, DeathChests, /homes and more!
- Bluemaps (live dynamap)
- Community events, including PvP, build contests and group competitions
- Separate creative server in the hub
- Whitelist only! Join the discord to join
- No PvP without consent, no stealing allowed (even out of claims)
